name: Reacher CM
subtitle: Unsigned Reacher CM builds for LiveContainer and sideloading
description: Unsigned iOS builds of Reacher CM, a personal fork of the Reach SSH, SFTP, RDP and VNC client, made by GitHub Actions for each release.

apps.name: Reacher CM
apps.subtitle: SSH, SFTP, RDP and VNC client
apps.localizedDescription: Reacher CM is a personal fork of Reach with additional features: SSH, SFTP, RDP, VNC, Telnet and serial sessions, an encrypted vault and sync. This is an early, unsigned iOS build, meant for LiveContainer or for signing yourself.

versions.localizedDescription:
Reacher CM Dev 26.11.1-dev.7, a pre-release built from the fork's main.

New since v26.11.1-dev.6:

- Session types grouped in the session editor
- Right-click menus in the full-pane file manager
- ZMODEM: buttons, folders
- Tunnels through saved SSH sessions
- GNOME Remote Login over RDP
- FreeRDP on X11
- SSH key passphrases with Windows Hello and macOS Touch ID
- FreeRDP for saved RDP sessions
- Forward lock key presses in RDP sessions

iPhone and iPad: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/update-feed/apps.json as a source in LiveContainer to get updates.
Full list of changes: https://github.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Reacher CM Dev 26.11.1-dev.6, a pre-release built from the fork's main.

New since v26.11.1-dev.5:

- Wider session editor with two columns
- Terminal type, Backspace key and encoding for SSH sessions
- Open sessions stand out in the session list
- Long press a session on a phone for its menu
- Remote desktop: held keys repeat, lock keys follow yours
- System theme with a light and a dark theme of your choice
- 11 colourful app themes
- Folder icons
- Password history
- A different jump host for each address
- X11 desktop sessions
- Connect with another saved credential
- SSH tab tooltip shows the algorithms in use
- Session tooltips show the other addresses themselves
- Quick command history
- Web sessions, with sign-in
- ZMODEM file transfer (rz/sz)
- Compatible SSH reaches servers with 2048-bit group exchange
- Removing a jump host sticks
- Remote desktop keeps its size when you switch tabs
- SPICE sessions

iPhone and iPad: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/update-feed/apps.json as a source in LiveContainer to get updates.
Full list of changes: https://github.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Reacher CM Dev 26.11.1-dev.5, a pre-release built from the fork's main.

New since v26.11.1-dev.4:

- WinBox 4 sessions
- Raspberry Pi OS detected
- Floating session windows
- Terminals without WebGL2 work
- Several addresses for one server
- IronRDP updated
- Full-pane file manager for SSH tabs
- Configurable keyboard shortcuts
- Session sharing works, and Start and Join are in the + menu
- Split the view any way, and drag panes where you want them
- Mute sounds, and a configurable terminal bell
- Find in the terminal's right-click menu, longer scrollback, line numbers and timestamps
- Log files named after the session
- Smoother text selection in the terminal on Linux
- What's new in an update
- Highlight errors and addresses in the terminal
- OS logos back in colour, and shown in the OS icon list
- More in a tab's right-click menu

iPhone and iPad: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/update-feed/apps.json as a source in LiveContainer to get updates.
Full list of changes: https://github.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Reacher CM Dev 26.11.1-dev.4, a pre-release built from the fork's main.

New since v26.11.1-dev.3:

- Face ID on iPhone and iPad, and SSH keys unlocked with biometrics on phones
- MikroTik and UniFi devices get their own icon
- Server fingerprints saved with the session
- Keys unlocked at start work outside credentials too
- Local shell history under the computer's name
- Longer first-run setup, and run it again from Settings
- Old name gone from messages
- Website, changelog and license in About
- Update check moved to About
- Pictures and file transfers on the RDP clipboard
- RDP files on phones and tablets
- See which sessions go through a jump host or proxy
- Close from the Session ended overlay

iPhone and iPad: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/update-feed/apps.json as a source in LiveContainer to get updates.
Full list of changes: https://github.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Reacher CM Dev 26.11.1-dev.3, a pre-release built from the fork's main.

New since v26.11.1-dev.2:

- Pictures and file transfers on the RDP clipboard
- Easy legacy SSH algorithms for old devices
- Password logins to servers that only ask through keyboard-interactive
- See which sessions go through a jump host or proxy
- RDP to GNOME Remote Desktop
- Put sessions in your own order
- Clone a session
- Show what you typed in password fields
- Scanning a link QR code no longer crashes on Android
- Selection cleared after a bulk edit
- iPhone and iPad: no app zoom, app fits above the keyboard
- No local terminal on phones and tablets
- No passphrase box while a session connects by itself
- Settings kept across restarts
- Selected text keeps its font on macOS
- Close the tab when a session ends

iPhone and iPad: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/update-feed/apps.json as a source in LiveContainer to get updates.
Full list of changes: https://github.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Reach connects to servers on your local network over SSH, RDP and VNC when you ask it to.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID unlocks your vault and the SSH keys you chose to remember with it.
